claim_boundary: The two pinned archives are audited byte-for-byte and exact pose-sequence copies are collapsed before counting. The dataset card contains only an Apache-2.0 tag. Its code maps IZQUIERDA to one and DERECHA to zero and performs a random file-level split, but does not document whether labels mean winner, touch side, referee call, or another task. Original videos, source-group IDs, events, athletes, weapon, frame rate, and annotation protocol are absent. Filename labels are therefore retained without semantic reinterpretation. The compact pose features are local inventory artifacts, not a leakage-safe external benchmark. A deliberately conservative translation/scale/reflection-invariant body-geometry fingerprint is supplied so possible transformed equivalents can stay in one split, but it is not an original-video identifier and cannot establish independent examples or generalization.
license: Dataset card declares Apache-2.0, but source-video, event, athlete, weapon, and annotation provenance are not documented
